title: Published planned assembly occurrences per 100,000 residents
formula: included listed scheduled occurrences / official residents * 100000
unit: listed assembly occurrences per 100,000 residents over seven days
population_basis: Destatis official population on 31 December 2024, Census 2022 basis; not municipal population-register figures
comparability: Selected-city comparison of published planned listings, not complete German protest activity or confirmed attendance. Publication practices and capture fidelity differ; rates are descriptive and not estimates of protest propensity.
publication_view: Aggregate-only summary of the recorded run, not the original retained result artifact.

cities.source_limitation: Published notifications, page updated twice daily. Count the dated rows in the captured listing; later changes and unlisted activity are unknown.
List excludes strikes and past assemblies and may omit short-notice assemblies. JSON Dateidatum is 29 Oct 2026; supplied copy retrieved 30 Oct. Withdrawn/cancelled and prohibited entries excluded.

Lower-fidelity research-tool text extract, retrieved 30 Oct 2026 according to preparation notes. Direct connection timeout reported in preparation. No original HTTP bytes captured here; absence from extract does not establish no activity.
